summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Sehat Saathi FastAPI service via public preview URL. 28/28 pytest cases passed covering profile upsert, emergency contact CRUD, medicines CRUD, schedule version history preservation, scheduled doses generation, dose-status persistence + idempotency, calendar aggregation (past/today/future buckets), daily notes, Gemini chat in English + Hindi (Devanagari script verified in response), and Gemini Vision OCR scan. OCR successfully extracted 'Metformin 500mg' from the generated JPEG and populated possible_match_medicine_id against the saved medicine. No MongoDB _id leakage detected in any endpoint. Dose history preserved across schedule version changes (schedules[] array grows, old dose events accessible). All endpoints return proper JSON with correct 200/404 status codes.

minor.issue: Returns raw JSON null (200 null) when resource not found. Acceptable, but a 404 would be more idiomatic. Frontend currently handles null — leaving as-is.
HTTPException(404) raised without a detail message — body is {"detail":"Not Found"} which is default. Minor UX nit.

`datetime.now().hour` uses server local time (likely UTC in container) while 'today' uses `date.today()` — a user in IST near midnight could see cutoff logic drift up to a few hours. Not blocking MVP but should use user-local time or an explicit tz in profile.

action_items: Optional: migrate /api/calendar cutoff logic to use user's local timezone (store tz in profile) instead of server local time.

Optional: pytest.ini pins xdist with loadscope which splits classes across workers; shared-state tests (MED_IDS dict) must be run with -n 0. Future test suites should either use pytest fixtures to share state or avoid cross-class module globals.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 570-line file. Still manageable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (medicines, doses, calendar, ai) once more endpoints are added.

In /api/scan the matching logic uses substring match (name in m.name OR vice versa). For 'Vit' vs 'VitaminD' this could create false positives. Consider using a stricter normalized compare (strip whitespace, lower, token-overlap >= threshold).
In _get_schedule_for_date, if start_date parsing fails there is no except — a corrupted schedule would 500 the whole /scheduled-doses call. Wrap in try/except like end_date.
set_dose_status returns the event dict directly from Mongo update — note _id is already stripped via dict-comprehension; OK.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_image_builder.py (new, builds realistic medicine package JPEG with Pillow)
seed_data_creation: All test data is prefixed with TEST_ and uses a fresh random device_key per run (TEST_device_<hex>). Medicines, profiles, emergency contacts, doses, chats and scans are inserted into the live preview MongoDB and are not cleaned up — safe because device_key isolation keeps them from colliding with any real user data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints are fully functional on https://dawai-saathi.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Use `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_sehat_backend.py -v -n 0` to rerun (the -n 0 is REQUIRED because the suite shares state across classes via the module-level MED_IDS dict, and pytest.ini forces xdist with loadscope which would split classes across workers). test_image_builder.py synthesizes a realistic medicine-package JPEG via Pillow for OCR testing — Gemini-3-flash-preview reliably extracts 'Metformin' from it, so the possible_match_medicine_id assertion is deterministic in current runs. If Gemini returns a different name, the matching test auto-skips rather than failing.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no production bugs found. Initial parallel-worker failure during the first pytest run was a test-infrastructure issue (xdist loadscope splitting TestMedicines and TestDoses onto different workers, so MED_IDS populated by one worker was invisible to the other). Resolved by running with -n 0.
